notes: The twelve spaces are the design bible's §3.13 table, verbatim in purpose and persistent proof and in its order. No thirteenth space is invented and none is dropped.

Six spaces have a world cell today: two approach cells authored before this card (reception terrace, processional ramp) and B6's four tomb interior cells. The other six carry worldCellId null and say so.
A site rule ID is opaque here. A7 owns what a site rule does; no rule mechanics, display names or registry are asserted by this record, and nothing in the crate reads a rule's meaning yet.
defaultOwnerConceptKey and corruptedVariantConceptKey are concept keys from the closed six-key set, never proper names: brief section 4 leaves faction names Open.
Which faction actually holds the tomb on a given day is the save's answer (S2 ownership through Geography::held_by), not this record's. This record says only which rule set each owner brings.

needs decision: what a corrupted variant does to a space that has no authored cell, and whether an owner outside the default and the corrupted variant brings a third rule set. select_site_rules gives every non-Cthulhu owner the default set, which is the honest reading of a two-set record.
